name: Access Request Decision for Other
description: Sent to a user when access was requested for them by another user and the reviewer of that request has made a decision.
subject: The access request from ${requesterName} for you has been #if($approved)approved#{else}denied#end
body:
#if ($approved)

Access has been granted to you

#else

An access request for you has been denied

#end

Hello ${user.name},

On ${dateRequested}, ${requesterName} requested access to ${requestedObjectName} for you.

#if(${requestedObjectType}=="Role" && ${accessRequestMetadata} && ${accessRequestMetadata.get("requestContextInformation")})

Requested dimension attributes:

    #foreach($key in ${accessRequestMetadata.get("requestContextInformation").keySet()})
  • ${key}: ${accessRequestMetadata.get("requestContextInformation").get($key)}
    • #end
#end#if ($approved)

Your access has been approved. The system is currently processing the creation of your access.

#if ($activationRequired)

This access requires activation before each use. To activate it, go to MySailPoint > Launchpad > Just-In-Time Access.

#end#if ($startDate)

Your access to ${requestedObjectName} is scheduled to start on ${startDate}.

#end#if ($removeDate)

Your access to ${requestedObjectName} is scheduled to end on ${removeDate}.

#end#{else}

Your access has been denied.

#if ($reviewerComment)

${rejecterName} included the following comment:
"$reviewerComment"

#{else}

Please contact ${rejecterName} if you have any questions.

#end#end

Best regards,
The ${PRODUCT_NAME} Team
